name: Sarah Finger McDonald

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Finger McDonald lists her occupation as state representative and her background as academic advisor, instructor and research associate at OSU.
bio.excerpt: Academic Advisor, Instructor, Research Associate, OSU

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book6)

bio.statement: Her statement lists a PhD from OSU, an MS from Virginia Tech and a BS from Notre Dame.
bio.excerpt: PhD, OSU; MS, Virginia Tech; BS, Notre Dame

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book6)

bio.statement: Her statement lists the Corvallis School Board as prior governmental experience.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book6)

bio.statement: Her official legislative page lists her as Democrat, District 16, Corvallis, and as vice-chair of the House Committee on Agriculture, Land Use, Natural Resources, and Water.
bio.excerpt: Vice-Chair of the House Committee on Agriculture, Land Use, Natural Resources, and Water

positions.statement: In a February 2026 Portland Tribune report on HB 4079, she said students should get information about the presence of immigration agents on campus.
positions.excerpt: we should assure that they get that information.

gaps: Her pamphlet statement refers readers to sarah4oregon.com for endorsements and names none, so no endorsements are recorded.
No roll-call votes were listed on her official legislative page; the Portland Tribune article on HB 4079 does not state her vote, so voting_record is empty.
She is the only candidate on the House District 16 ballot per the inventory.
